summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I already checked (read-only, no edits made) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  Findings so far: - **Client:** No localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in `WatchlistPage.tsx`. Loads via `GET /watchlist` on mount, always uses the `activeId` returned by the server, saves via `POST/DELETE /watchlist/:id/items`. `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every call. - **Server:** `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth
